answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Jabesh-gilead: its destruction for missing the assembly, its rescue from Nahash, and its men's burial of Saul.

clauses.english: was struck with the sword for sending no one to the assembly at Mizpeh, and four hundred virgins were taken
clauses.quote: Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead with the edge of the sword

clauses.english: was besieged by Nahash the Ammonite and was rescued by Saul
clauses.quote: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead

clauses.english: sent its valiant men to take Saul's body from Bethshan and bury his bones
clauses.quote: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul

doubts: The 1SA 11:12 context and 1SA 10:27 do not name Jabesh; 1SA 10:27 is marked but concerns Saul being despised, so I left it out.
The rescue clause rests on 1SA 11:11, a context verse that does not name Jabesh, together with the marked verses.
